name: ARTH 3220W
title: Early Medieval Art
description: Early medieval art from the fifth through the tenth centuries. Germanic metalwork, Hiberno-Saxon manuscripts, and the art of the era of Charlemagne and his successors.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to Art History and Art majors, others with consent of instructor; open to juniors or higher.
